title: Rayman 3
statusNote: Intro, title, main menu, help and the story screens work; a new game in the first save slot starts the first level, where Rayman runs, jumps and punches and the pause menu opens.
notes: Single Player has three save slots; pick an empty one to start. The story pages before the first level can be skipped with the left soft key.

Multiplayer (Host Game, Join Game) works between two players in one room of the site (Menu > Multiplayer): one chooses Host Game, the other Join Game and then the host it finds; the host starts the match. A Capture the Flag match between two players was played this way.

multiplayer.statusNote: Two players in one room: one hosts, the other joins and picks the host, the host starts; a Capture the Flag match ran on both screens, and the host is told when the other player leaves. Tried with the original game, not with the Polish translation, which runs the same program. More than two players were not tried.

controls.source: The game's Help screens (menu keys, move, jump, punch, pause). OK selecting in menus was observed.

actions.up: Move Rayman; move the arrow in menus
actions.down: Move Rayman; move the arrow in menus
actions.left: Move left; change an option in menus
actions.right: Move right; change an option in menus
actions.lsk: Pause; select in menus; skip the story

notes: Platformer layout: jump (5) on Space or Z and punch (7) on X, besides the digit keys. On a gamepad A jumps, X or B punches and Y is OK; in menus A selects and B goes back.
